name: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Royal Reimagined'
story_html: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG ‘Royal Reimagined’ brings back the original 1985 colorway utilizing different materials. Replacing the leather construction of the original, the upper is draped in smooth suede, featuring a black base with contrasting royal blue accents on the toe box, Swoosh, heel and collar overlay. The latter is marked with the iconic Jordan Wings logo, while a woven Nike Air tag adorns the breathable nylon tongue. The classic silhouette is mounted on a sturdy rubber cupsole, highlighted by white sidewalls and a grippy royal blue outsole.
